Reimaging Health

Reimagined Health Journeys are experiences we dream of providing our citizens, health workers and professionals. These comic strips describing what success looks and feels like, are tools for collective brainstorming and goal-setting. They represent a visceral, shared vision for how to reimagine our health system to achieve universal health care.
